name: IC Power Switching Regulator — buck, 1.8V — QFN
description: Surface-mount buck switching regulator IC cluster featuring 1.8V output configuration in 3x3mm QFN and VQFN 16-pin packages with exposed pads.
selection_hints: Select when requiring a surface-mount 1.8V buck switching regulator in a 3x3mm QFN package.
Check specific footprint thermal pad dimensions (EP 1.68x1.68mm vs 1.7x1.7mm) and thermal via layout.
Prefer Tier A part PAM2305BJE180 when available over Tier B options (TPS62131, TPS62141, TPS62151).
avoid_when: Do not use if through-hole mounting or packages other than QFN/VQFN are required.
Avoid when regulator topologies other than step-down (buck) or output ratings other than 1.8V are needed.
